answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable quartz deposit and earn standing only through work that established peers attest over time, like a meadow that grows one blade at a time. A newcomer starts with no trust and must complete checkable tasks before it can transact or vote, so each fake identity needs its own deposit and its own history of real work. Creating a thousand Sybils then costs a thousand deposits and a thousand work histories, while one honest agent pays once. A peer caught vouching for a fake loses its deposit and standing, so the ember of trust is earned slowly and lost fast.
